fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/run (or internal/api) retries a run failed at a step reached from a command step's on.fail, itself entered from a wait's on.pass, and shows it reopening at that wait, choosing between two such predecessors from the journal; a run failed at a step with neither still retries at that step; testscript run-resume-retry (or a new run-ship-retry-ci-triage with a fake gh) retries a ship-change run failed at ci-triage after the PR head turned green and it passes wait-pr and pr-green on to signoff; run with go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/api/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-resume-retry|run-ship-retry)' only
fields.statement: rhiza run resume --retry on a run that failed at a step with no wait whose on.pass it is (ship-change's ci-triage) reads from the journal the step visited just before it, the check whose on.fail routed into it (pr-green or rebased-green), and reopens the run at that check's wait step (wait-pr or wait-rebased), so the retry waits for CI on the current or a new head and re-runs the check: green goes on to signoff or land, red goes to ci-triage again with fresh state; a failed step reached by no on.fail edge still retries at itself

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api show ship check --settled --changed not settling on an unchanged settled red head, settling on a new head or a newer check run attempt once it finishes, and the timeout detail naming the infra failure; testscript run-ship-rerun-fail (or a new run-ship-infra-wait with a fake gh) drives a ship-change run whose CI fails with no failing test into wait-ci-rerun, then a rerun turns the head green and the run passes pr-green to signoff; run with go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ./internal/workflow/... and go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-rerun-fail|run-ship-infra-wait|run-ship-ci-fix)' only
fields.statement: When ship-change's ci-triage finds no failing test for a red head (an infra or unparsable failure), the run goes to a new wait step wait-ci-rerun instead of ending: its until, rhiza ship check --settled --changed, settles only once CI moved past the state ci-triage judged (a new head SHA, or a check run or attempt newer than the head's latest ship-check record) and that new CI finished; it waits up to 6h with max_visits 3, its timeout ends the run with a line naming the infra failure, and its on.pass goes to pr-green, which re-checks the head (a run back from after the rebase passes signoff again)
